title: Denominator kernel of the scalar-extension unit on ordinary complex cohomology
statement: Let A,Aq be commutative rings in one universe, Aq an A-algebra localized at a submonoid S of A, C any cochain complex of A-modules, i in Z and x in H^i(C). If H^i of the extension-restriction adjunction unit C -> restrict_A(Aq tensor_A C) kills x, then some s in S satisfies s*x=0.

proof.text: IsLocalization.flat and ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat make scalar extension exact; restriction is exact as well. Their composite therefore preserves homology.

Apply ShortComplex.homologyMap_mapNatTrans to the adjunction unit on C.sc(i). Conjugate the class map by the exact-functor homology comparison isomorphisms. Its kernel is thereby the kernel of the module scalar-extension unit on H^i(C).

Normalize the algebra structure via Algebra.algebra_ext. IsLocalization.tensorProduct_isLocalizedModule identifies the module unit with a localized-module map. IsLocalizedModule.exists_of_eq applied to its equality with the image of zero gives s. Transport s*x=0 through the A-linear source homology comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem complexLocalizationUnit_kernel (A Aq : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing Aq]
    [Algebra A Aq] (S : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization S Aq] (i : ℤ)
    (C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (x : C.homology i)
    (hx : (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      (((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (algebraMap A Aq)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).unit.app C) i) x = 0) :
    ∃ s : S, (s : A) • x = 0
